morning.caption:
An updated Desert Research Institute study says proposed Nevada data centers could use about 12,800 acre-feet of water a year for cooling by 2036, and about 21,300 more at the power plants that supply them. Supply will come from groundwater, reclamation or transfers.

Full edition: watercapitalwire.com

afternoon.caption:
California Water Service Group becomes Watermark Utilities on November 30, keeping the CWT ticker. The utility serves more than 2.2 million people in five states and plans to expand into Nevada and Oregon before year end.

More: watercapitalwire.com

evening.caption:
The Saudi Water Authority has cancelled the tender for a 300 million liter a day desalination plant at Yanbu, awarded to India's VA Tech Wabag for about $272 million in July 2025. WABAG disclosed the cancellation on November 14.
